title: Looks good, missing recipe ebook info
text:
Looks good, missing recipe ebook info. Seems like a good product, has everything you need, EXCEPT the 50 recipe ebook. It even says that comes with it on the box, but doesn't list the link on the box, and there is no flyer or anything like it inside the box. I did read in the questions, where to find the ebook.
The answer is it should be emailed to buyer. I double checked, I did not receive the email with the link. For that reason, I give it just 2 stars.
